theme.en: Memory suppliers lock in AI leverage

dek.en: New HBM yield claims, long-term supply agreements, and SK hynix fab spending point to memory becoming a tighter strategic input for AI systems. At the same time, Apple’s CXMT testing and Huawei’s rise sharpen the competitive pressure around China.
dek.zh: 新的HBM良率进展、长期供货协议和SK hynix的晶圆厂投资表明，存储正成为AI系统中更紧缺、更具战略性的投入品。与此同时，Apple测试CXMT产品以及Huawei的崛起，也在加剧中国市场的竞争压力。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: Two Nvidia RTX Spark variants appear in Geekbench
title.zh: 两款Nvidia RTX Spark型号现身Geekbench

summary.en: Geekbench listings show a full 20-core RTX Spark and a cut-down 18-core version. The 20-core part scored 2,570 single-core and 23,126 multi-core points, versus 2,541 and 21,776 for the 18-core model. The result suggests Nvidia may offer a more segmented Spark lineup for local AI and workstation-style workloads.
summary.zh: Geekbench记录显示，RTX Spark有完整的20核版本和精简的18核版本。20核型号单核得分为2,570、多核为23,126；18核型号则为2,541和21,776。该结果表明Nvidia可能会为本地AI及工作站类负载提供更细分的Spark产品线。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: TSMC Longtan science-park talks resume
title.zh: TSMC龙潭科学园区讨论重启

summary.en: Discussions over TSMC’s Longtan science-park plans have resumed, reopening a possible path for additional Taiwanese manufacturing capacity. The significance is less an immediate capacity addition than the return of a local-site option as advanced-node demand and infrastructure constraints continue to shape expansion plans.
summary.zh: 围绕TSMC龙潭科学园区计划的讨论已经重启，为其在台湾追加制造产能重新打开了一条可能路径。其意义不在于立即增加产能，而在于先进制程需求和基础设施约束持续影响扩产时，本地选址方案重新回到议程。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: SK hynix plans ₩54.3 trillion for new semiconductor fabs
title.zh: SK hynix计划投资54.3万亿韩元新建半导体晶圆厂

summary.en: SK hynix is reported to be planning ₩54.3 trillion in investment for new semiconductor fabs. The scale signals that the company is treating AI-memory demand as a multiyear capacity commitment rather than a short-cycle shortage. Execution, including timing and product mix, will matter for how much of that investment translates into HBM and advanced DRAM supply.
summary.zh: 据报道，SK hynix计划投入54.3万亿韩元建设新的半导体晶圆厂。这一规模表明，该公司把AI存储需求视为多年期的产能承诺，而非短周期的供给紧张。投资能有多少转化为HBM和先进DRAM供给，仍取决于建设节奏与产品组合。

title.en: Samsung reportedly reaches 80% HBM4 yield and advances HBM4E
title.zh: Samsung据报HBM4良率达到80%，并加快HBM4E推进

summary.en: Samsung has reportedly reached an 80% yield on HBM4 and is accelerating HBM4E production preparations. If sustained in volume manufacturing, that would improve Samsung’s ability to challenge the incumbent HBM supply position held by SK hynix and Micron. Yield claims need to be distinguished from qualified, customer-shipping output, but they are a key indicator before platform ramps.
summary.zh: 据报道，Samsung的HBM4良率已达到80%，并在加快HBM4E量产准备。若能在大规模制造中保持这一水平，Samsung将更有能力挑战SK hynix和Micron在HBM供应中的既有地位。良率数据仍需与通过客户验证并实际出货的产量区分，但在平台放量前，它是重要的先行指标。

title.en: SK hynix outlines 16-high HBM4 and 375-layer wafer-bonded NAND
title.zh: SK hynix展示16层堆叠HBM4与375层晶圆键合NAND

summary.en: At FMS 2026, SK hynix presented a roadmap including 16-high HBM4 and wafer-bonded 375-layer NAND. The announcements span both the bandwidth-hungry AI memory stack and high-density flash, showing how the company is positioning multiple tiers of memory for data-center systems. The roadmaps are technology disclosures rather than confirmed volume-shipment milestones.
summary.zh: 在FMS 2026上，SK hynix展示了包括16层堆叠HBM4和375层晶圆键合NAND在内的路线图。这些信息同时覆盖高带宽AI存储栈和高密度闪存，显示其正为数据中心系统布局多层级存储。该路线图属于技术披露，并不等同于已确认的大规模出货节点。

title.en: Five-year supply contracts reportedly become a semiconductor norm
title.zh: 五年期供货合同据报正成为半导体行业常态

summary.en: A report says five-year supply contracts are becoming standard practice across the semiconductor industry. Longer commitments can give suppliers greater visibility for capital spending while locking customers into pricing and allocation terms. Their spread would mark a structural change from the historically volatile spot-driven memory market, though terms and enforceability vary by contract.
summary.zh: 一篇报道指出，五年期供货合同正成为半导体行业的常见做法。更长的承诺期可提高供应商对资本开支的可见度，同时将客户锁定在价格和配额条款中。若这一趋势扩大，将意味着行业正偏离历史上由现货价格主导的高波动存储市场，但具体条款和约束力仍因合同而异。

title.en: Advance DRAM commitments reportedly reach $38 billion
title.zh: DRAM预付款承诺据报达到380亿美元

summary.en: An industry analysis puts advance commitments held by major DRAM suppliers at $38 billion and argues that long-term contracts and price floors are strengthening supplier leverage. Samsung, SK hynix, and Micron would have more predictable revenue and customers less room to switch during tight supply. The $38 billion figure is an analysis estimate, not a disclosed aggregate from the manufacturers.
summary.zh: 一项行业分析称，主要DRAM供应商获得的预付款承诺已达380亿美元，并认为长期合同和价格底线正在增强供应商的议价能力。Samsung、SK hynix和Micron将拥有更可预测的收入，而在供给紧张时期，客户的切换空间会变小。380亿美元为分析估算，并非这些厂商披露的合计数字。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: Apple tests CXMT memory for iPhones and Macs
title.zh: Apple测试用于iPhone和Mac的CXMT存储芯片

summary.en: Apple is reported to be testing memory chips from China’s CXMT for iPhones and Macs. Even a limited qualification effort would give Apple another potential source as AI-driven memory demand tightens supply and raises costs. Actual adoption would still depend on performance, reliability, volume capacity, and the regulatory environment around Chinese components.
summary.zh: 据报道，Apple正在测试中国CXMT用于iPhone和Mac的存储芯片。即便只是有限的认证工作，在AI驱动的存储需求收紧供给、推高成本之际，也可能为Apple增加一个潜在来源。实际采用仍取决于性能、可靠性、量产能力，以及围绕中国零部件的监管环境。

title.en: Forecast sees Nvidia China AI-chip share falling from 40% to 8%
title.zh: 预测称Nvidia中国AI芯片份额将从40%降至8%

summary.en: A forecast cited by MarketScale projects Nvidia’s China AI-chip share could fall from 40% to 8% as Huawei scales. The forecast highlights how export restrictions and domestic alternatives are changing the addressable market even for the leading AI-accelerator supplier. It is a projection rather than reported market data, so its assumptions on product availability and Huawei execution are decisive.
summary.zh: MarketScale援引的一项预测认为，随着Huawei扩大规模，Nvidia在中国AI芯片市场的份额可能从40%降至8%。这一预测凸显了出口限制和本土替代品如何改变即使是领先AI加速器供应商的可服务市场。这是预测而非已公布的市场统计，因此其对产品可得性和Huawei执行力的假设至关重要。

title.en: Challengers
title.zh: 新兴挑战者

title.en: ChipAgent raises $130 million for AI-assisted EDA
title.zh: ChipAgent为AI辅助EDA融资1.3亿美元

summary.en: ChipAgent has raised $130 million, according to SemiWiki. The funding is notable because AI-assisted verification and design automation have become one of the more active EDA investment areas as chip projects grow in complexity. Revenue durability and adoption inside established design flows will be more meaningful tests than funding size alone.
summary.zh: 据SemiWiki报道，ChipAgent已融资1.3亿美元。这笔融资值得关注，因为随着芯片项目复杂度提高，AI辅助验证和设计自动化已成为EDA投资最活跃的领域之一。比融资规模更重要的检验，将是其收入的可持续性以及在成熟设计流程中的采用情况。

theme.en: Inference efficiency shifts across the stack

dek.en: This week’s papers connect low-bit formats, sparsity, scheduling, and memory-centric circuits to the practical cost of serving models. The strongest results range from silicon prototypes to system-level measurements, with several claims still based on simulation or preprint evaluation.
dek.zh: 本周论文将低比特格式、稀疏性、调度和以存储为中心的电路，连接到模型服务的实际成本问题。最有力的结果覆盖硅原型和系统级测量，但也有若干结论仍基于仿真或预印本评估。

title.en: Devices & Process
title.zh: 器件与工艺

title.en: Ferroelectric Hafnium Oxide for In-Memory Computing
title.zh: 面向存算一体的铁电氧化铪

papers.authors: Chen He, Wei Li, Jianjun Li, et al.

summary.en: This review connects hafnia-based ferroelectric materials, memory devices, circuit primitives, and system-level in-memory computing. It explains how polarization engineering and defect control constrain precision, endurance, scalability, and the circuit functions that can be implemented. The article is a synthesis rather than a new device demonstration, but it is useful for separating CMOS-compatible promise from integration bottlenecks.
summary.zh: 这篇综述将基于氧化铪的铁电材料、存储器件、电路原语和系统级存算一体联系起来。文章说明极化工程和缺陷控制如何约束精度、耐久性、可扩展性以及可实现的电路功能。它并非新的器件演示，但有助于区分CMOS兼容的潜力与集成瓶颈。

title.en: Circuits & Architectures
title.zh: 电路与体系结构

title.en: A 350-pW 65-nm CMOS arrhythmia detector with Bayesian uncertainty
title.zh: 采用贝叶斯不确定性量化的350 pW、65 nm CMOS心律失常检测器

papers.authors: Zephan M. Enciso, Jianbo Liu, Boyang Cheng, et al.

summary.en: The authors report a 0.816-mm² implantable ventricular-arrhythmia detection engine in 65-nm CMOS that consumes 350 pW. It combines a digital one-dimensional convolution front end with a mixed-signal compute-in-memory Bayesian classifier and a 360-fJ/sample random-number generator. Integrating uncertainty estimates is important for selective prediction, although clinical performance and robustness remain separate validation questions.
summary.zh: 作者报告了一款采用65 nm CMOS、面积0.816 mm²、功耗350 pW的植入式室性心律失常检测引擎。该芯片将数字一维卷积前端与混合信号存算一体贝叶斯分类器及360 fJ/样本随机数发生器结合。集成不确定性估计对选择性预测很重要，但临床性能与鲁棒性仍需独立验证。

title.en: A 94.8-nW battery-free intelligent silicon platform
title.zh: 功耗94.8 nW的无电池智能硅平台

papers.authors: Haochen Zhang, Wei-Han Yu, Zhongyu Zhao, et al.

summary.en: This 65-nm CMOS platform targets distributed multimodal sensing with event-driven computing and digital compute-in-memory. It reports 94.8 nW in inference mode, 340.4 nW during training, and 90.6% accuracy on a condition-monitoring task. The result shows how sparsity-aware scheduling and low-bit learning can stretch energy budgets, though the reported workload is much narrower than general-purpose edge AI.
summary.zh: 该65 nm CMOS平台面向分布式多模态感测，采用事件驱动计算和数字存算一体。论文报告其推理模式功耗为94.8 nW、训练模式为340.4 nW，并在状态监测任务上获得90.6%的准确率。结果表明稀疏性感知调度和低比特学习能够延展能耗预算，但所报告负载远窄于通用边缘AI。

title.en: VCMA-MRAM in-memory arithmetic for subtractors and dividers
title.zh: 用于减法器和除法器的VCMA-MRAM存内算术架构

papers.authors: Qilong Tang, Wei Duan, Zijun Zhu, et al.

summary.en: The paper proposes a voltage-controlled magnetic-anisotropy MRAM architecture that performs logic directly inside the array to build subtractors and dividers. In 45-nm CMOS simulation, the design reports 512 GOPS peak throughput and 99.853 TOPS/W; its 8-bit subtractor is claimed to reduce area by 43.85% and latency by 53.66%. These are simulation-based figures, so device variation, write reliability, and peripheral cost remain central implementation risks.
summary.zh: 论文提出一种基于电压控制磁各向异性MRAM的架构，在阵列内直接执行逻辑以构建减法器和除法器。在45 nm CMOS仿真中，该设计报告峰值吞吐量512 GOPS、能效99.853 TOPS/W；其8位减法器据称面积减少43.85%、延迟降低53.66%。这些数值基于仿真，因此器件波动、写入可靠性和外围电路成本仍是关键实现风险。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Compute-in-Memory
title.zh: AI加速器与存算一体

title.en: AdaMX: Heterogeneity-aware microscaling for low-bit LLM inference
title.zh: AdaMX：面向低比特LLM推理的异构感知微缩放

papers.authors: Junyi Luo, Xin Jiang, Tai-Hao Wen, et al.

summary.en: AdaMX selects precision-recovery schemes per block and different representations for weights and activations, rather than applying one MXFP4 treatment everywhere. The team implements the decoder, compute unit, and quantization logic in a 22-nm FD-SOI accelerator prototype, reporting roughly 1% system-energy overhead versus an otherwise identical MXFP4 accelerator. The work is useful because it puts hardware cost beside quantization flexibility, but the reported comparison depends on the chosen baseline and models.
summary.zh: AdaMX按块选择精度恢复机制，并为权重和激活采用不同表示，而不是在所有位置使用同一种MXFP4处理方式。团队在22 nm FD-SOI加速器原型中实现了解码器、计算单元和量化逻辑，报告相对同等MXFP4加速器约1%的系统能耗开销。该工作将硬件成本与量化灵活性并置，但其比较结果依赖于所选基线和模型。

title.en: Celty: GPU kernel and SIMT co-design for dual-sparse LLM inference
title.zh: Celty：面向双稀疏LLM推理的GPU内核与SIMT协同设计

summary.en: Celty targets the sparse-matrix–sparse-vector workload created when weight pruning meets runtime activation sparsity in single-user LLM decoding. It co-designs an RLC-CSC sparse format, GPU kernel, and a SIMT core with a pipelined decoder to avoid costly index reconstruction and memory accesses. The idea addresses a real mismatch between sparsity algorithms and commodity kernels, while the microarchitecture portion remains a proposed design rather than deployed GPU silicon.
summary.zh: Celty针对单用户LLM解码中权重剪枝与运行时激活稀疏叠加形成的稀疏矩阵—稀疏向量负载。它协同设计RLC-CSC稀疏格式、GPU内核和带流水线解码器的SIMT核心，以避免高代价的索引重建和内存访问。该思路解决了稀疏算法与通用内核间的真实错配，但其中的微架构部分仍是提案，而非已部署的GPU硅实现。

title.en: DSLA: dual-sparsity LLM accelerator with HiMix-BFP
title.zh: DSLA：采用HiMix-BFP的双稀疏LLM加速器

papers.authors: Zikang Zhou, Siyao Dai, Yaqi Chen, et al.
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems I: Regular Papers

summary.en: DSLA combines a HiMix block-floating-point representation with exploitation of sparsity in both data and bit slices for edge LLM inference. The paper argues that conventional BFP and bidirectional BFP lose too much accuracy at ultra-low precision because of outliers. Its contribution is an accelerator-oriented way to recover accuracy while turning exponent-alignment behavior into an additional energy-saving opportunity; deployment results will determine the practical gain.
summary.zh: DSLA将HiMix块浮点表示与数据和位片两个层面的稀疏性利用结合，用于边缘LLM推理。论文认为，传统BFP和双向BFP在超低精度下会因离群值损失过多准确率。其贡献在于以加速器为导向恢复精度，同时把指数对齐行为转化为额外节能机会；实际部署结果将决定其可获得的收益。

title.en: AI Systems & Inference
title.zh: AI系统与推理

title.en: OrionInfer: adaptive parallelism and live migration for LLM serving
title.zh: OrionInfer：用于LLM服务的自适应并行与在线迁移

papers.authors: Jingqi Feng, Guang Yang, Yukai Huang, et al.
papers.venue: Proceedings of the 32nd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining V.2

summary.en: OrionInfer switches between data parallelism and tensor parallelism at runtime, while using live migration to rebalance memory pressure. The authors report up to 25% lower average time-to-first-token than a data-parallel-priority configuration at low load, and 50%–90% lower P99 tail latency than a tensor-parallel-priority configuration in many high-traffic cases. The work makes serving policy dynamic, though benefits will depend on migration overhead and the workload mix at an operator.
summary.zh: OrionInfer可在运行时切换数据并行与张量并行，并通过在线迁移重新平衡内存压力。作者报告，在低负载下，相比优先数据并行的配置，平均首Token时间最多降低25%；在许多高流量场景中，相比优先张量并行的配置，P99尾延迟降低50%至90%。该工作使服务策略动态化，但收益仍取决于迁移开销和运营方的实际负载组合。

title.en: EdgeXpert: MoE and speculative decoding for memory-efficient edge inference
title.zh: EdgeXpert：面向高效边缘推理的MoE与推测解码

papers.authors: Sangwoo Ha, Hyunwoo Seo, Y. Jo, et al.

summary.en: EdgeXpert is a hardware–software co-design that combines mixture-of-experts routing with speculative decoding for on-device LLMs. It uses prompt-wise expert reuse in prefill and depth-aware expert coalescing in decoding to reduce external-memory traffic. The paper targets an important edge bottleneck, but its claimed advantage rests on how well expert reuse preserves model quality across prompts and candidate tokens.
summary.zh: EdgeXpert是一项软硬件协同设计，将Mixture-of-Experts路由与推测解码结合，用于端侧LLM。它在prefill阶段使用按提示词复用专家，在解码阶段使用深度感知的专家合并，以降低外部存储访问。论文瞄准了重要的边缘瓶颈，但其优势取决于专家复用能否在不同提示词和候选Token间保持模型质量。

title.en: LLM Serving in the Wild: framework adoption in open-source systems
title.zh: 真实世界中的LLM服务：开源系统中的框架采用情况

papers.authors: Forough Majidi, Mohammad Mehdi Morovati, F. Khomh, et al.

summary.en: This empirical study examines how open-source projects use vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, LMDeploy, and FlashInfer. It finds vLLM is the most visible framework, while parallel computation, memory management, and network pruning are the most common serving-method categories; multi-framework use is limited. That evidence is a useful counterweight to benchmark-driven claims, although public repositories may not represent proprietary production deployments.
summary.zh: 这项实证研究考察了开源项目如何使用vLLM、SGLang、TensorRT-LLM、LMDeploy和FlashInfer。研究发现vLLM的可见度和采用度最高，并行计算、内存管理和网络剪枝是最常见的服务方法类别；多框架并用较少。这一证据可为基准测试驱动的主张提供现实参照，但公开仓库未必代表专有生产部署。
